_comment: Judge counterfactual v26 (explicit_refusal / coarser). Only models (scalar entries), runtime.request_timeout_seconds and credentials are read by run_judge_counterfactual_v25.py. Values copied from ci-gate-v22-feedback-571.json (the v25 config) except the Ollama key pool: key (key 1) at most 3 concurrent requests, key2 at most 7, total 10 = models.max_concurrent_requests. The pool is process-wide, so run all Ollama models in ONE process and run no other Ollama job on these keys at the same time.
